# casdoor_plan (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor plan, a recurring price that users subscribe to.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_plan" "pro_monthly" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "pro-monthly"
  display_name = "Pro (monthly)"
  price        = 19
  currency     = "USD"
  period       = "Monthly"
  role         = "${casdoor_role.admins.owner}/${casdoor_role.admins.name}"
  is_enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the plan, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `currency` (String) The currency, e.g. `USD`.
- `description` (String) The description.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the plan is enabled.
- `is_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether a user can have at most one subscription of the plan.
- `options` (List of String) The features listed on the pricing page.
- `payment_providers` (List of String) The names of the payment providers.
- `period` (String) The billing period, `Monthly` or `Yearly`.
- `price` (Number) The price per period.
- `product` (String) The product that is bought when subscribing to the plan.
- `role` (String) The role that subscribers get.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the plan was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the plan in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_plan.example <organization>/<name>
```
